decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall only be used for the preparation and sale of food, including hot food, for consumption off the premises and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Classes A1, A2, A3 and A4 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 2010, or in any provision equivalent to those Classes in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Plan, ALMN01, Design & Access Statement Received 22/03/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at, or dispatched from, the site between the hours of 7am-9am and 4pm-7pm
Condition : 5 - The ventilation system when operating at its maximum level shall be 10dB(A) below existing background noise levels and shall be mounted on anti-vibration mountings.

Condition : 6 - The extract system hereby approved shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-carbon and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher. The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced.
Condition : 7 - All refuse on site should be dealt with in accordance with the submitted Refuse Plan
description: Replace existing catering unit with new larger unit
